scope: Explicit POSITION/XYZWPR composition, inversion and point-defined FRAME

reference_basis.documented: Relative transform precedence and composition; POSITION FRAME points and INV input/output; first/fourth origin and configuration; 10 mm geometry bounds; protected POSITION orientation
reference_basis.uncertainty: Native mixed-type overload/result selection, tolerance, Euler/configuration equivalence and compiler/controller behavior remain unverified

implementation_choices.types: Exact complete POSITION or XYZWPR operands; INV preserves representation; colon and FRAME return POSITION if any argument is POSITION, otherwise XYZWPR; internal user routines retain precedence
implementation_choices.matrix: POSITION columns NORMAL/ORIENT/APPROACH with LOCATION XYZ; direct matrix calculations without intermediate Euler extraction; inputs/results require unit column norms, zero pairwise dot products and determinant +1, each within absolute 1e-9; no matrix repair
implementation_choices.xyzwpr: Existing Z-Y-X rotation convention and canonical/gimbal Euler output retained for XYZWPR-only operations
implementation_choices.frame: Existing three/four-point axes and inclusive 10 mm bounds; validate complete input orientation even though axes use only locations; copy first or fourth origin/CONFIG
implementation_choices.configuration: Colon copies right CONFIG; inverse copies input CONFIG; no robot turn or joint inference
implementation_choices.ownership: Independent result data and recursively read-only POSITION orientation; stable existing destination field references; grouped orientation value arguments detach writable VECTOR storage
implementation_choices.effects: Evaluate once left-to-right; snapshot and validate each operand before later effects; FRAME distance checks after capture; preserve earlier effects and destination on failure; exact routine interfaces and ordinary FOR/frame cleanup
implementation_choices.reports: Actual operand_types and result_type in source-located frame_operations; origin_argument for FRAME; frame_policy records result selection, tolerance and remaining boundaries; field inspection does not emit duplicate sites

retained_boundaries: No XYZWPREXT/JOINTPOS/VECTOR geometry operands, automatic parameter/RETURN coercion or direct POSITION orientation writes
No controller context, external axes, native kinematics, configuration inference or native acceptance
Strict remains future work; independent quaternion and fixture checks establish offline geometry only
